indic.ordinary_space: each ordinary space becomes the space mark
indic.merge: highest indic_score that exists as a piece merges first
indic.equal_scores: equal scores merge the leftmost pair
indic.unknown_character: a character with no piece becomes <0xHH> bytes

router.protected_whitespace: Protected whitespace is a tab, a newline, a carriage return, or two or more spaces. Those runs take the English path and split the text into stretches.
router.indic_and_no_latin: Indic letters and no Latin letters: the whole stretch takes the Indic path, including digits, punctuation, and single spaces.
router.latin_and_no_indic: Latin letters and no Indic letters: the whole stretch takes the English path.
router.neither: No Indic letters and no Latin letters: English.
router.both_scripts: Both scripts: split on single spaces. In a word, a Latin letter is English and an Indic letter is Indic. Digits, punctuation, and other symbols attach to the run on their left. If the word starts with them, they attach to the run on their right. A word made only of them is English. A single space is pulled into the Indic path only when the spans on both sides are Indic.
router.latin_letter: A Latin letter is Unicode category Lu, Ll, Lt, Lm, or Lo whose name starts with "LATIN ".
router.indic_letter: An Indic letter is a character in the kept Indic blocks already named in the encoder: bengali, devanagari, gujarati, kannada, tamil, telugu.
router.zwj_zwnj: U+200D and U+200C count as Indic when the nearest real letter, skipping those two characters, is Indic.

specials.normal_text: encoding normal text does not emit ids 0-31
